help.short: The name of the Time Series Insights environment associated with the specified resource group.
The name of the Time Series Insights event source associated with the specified environment.

description: Get the event source with the specified name in the specified environment.

operations.description: Gets the event source with the specified name in the specified environment.

params.description: The name of the Time Series Insights environment associated with the specified resource group.
params.name: environmentName

params.description: The name of the Time Series Insights event source associated with the specified environment.
params.name: eventSourceName

params.description: Name of an Azure Resource group.
params.name: resourceGroupName

consts.description: Version of the API to be used with the client request.
consts.name: api-version

props.description: Properties of the EventHub event source resource.
props.name: properties

props.description: The name of the event hub's consumer group that holds the partitions from which events will be read.
props.name: consumerGroupName

props.description: The time the resource was created.
props.name: creationTime

props.description: The name of the event hub.
props.name: eventHubName

props.description: The resource id of the event source in Azure Resource Manager.
props.name: eventSourceResourceId

props.description: An object that contains the details about the starting point in time to ingest events.
props.name: ingressStartAt

props.description: ISO8601 UTC datetime with seconds precision (milliseconds are optional), specifying the date and time that will be the starting point for Events to be consumed.
props.name: time

props.description: The type of the ingressStartAt, It can be "EarliestAvailable", "EventSourceCreationTime", "CustomEnqueuedTime".
props.name: type

props.description: The name of the SAS key that grants the Time Series Insights service access to the event hub. The shared access policies for this key must grant 'Listen' permissions to the event hub.
props.name: keyName

props.description: An object that represents the local timestamp property. It contains the format of local timestamp that needs to be used and the corresponding timezone offset information. If a value isn't specified for localTimestamp, or if null, then the local timestamp will not be ingressed with the events.
props.name: localTimestamp

props.description: An enum that represents the format of the local timestamp property that needs to be set.
props.name: format

props.description: An object that represents the offset information for the local timestamp format specified. Should not be specified for LocalTimestampFormat - Embedded.
props.name: timeZoneOffset

props.description: The event property that will be contain the offset information to calculate the local timestamp. When the LocalTimestampFormat is Iana, the property name will contain the name of the column which contains IANA Timezone Name (eg: Americas/Los Angeles). When LocalTimestampFormat is Timespan, it contains the name of property which contains values representing the offset (eg: P1D or 1.00:00:00)
props.name: propertyName

props.description: Provisioning state of the resource.
props.name: provisioningState

props.description: The name of the service bus that contains the event hub.
props.name: serviceBusNamespace

props.description: The event property that will be used as the event source's timestamp. If a value isn't specified for timestampPropertyName, or if null or empty-string is specified, the event creation time will be used.
props.name: timestampPropertyName

props.description: The name of the iot hub.
